   - Annual revenue = 646 * 230 = 148,580

   \[
   \text{Net annual profit} \times n \geq \text{Initial cost}
   \]
   \[
   147,866 \times n \geq 80
   \]

   \[
   n \geq \frac{80}{147,866}
   \]
   \[
